entities.summary: Tor Nils Hilding Meinander was a Finland-Swedish economist, journalist and politician. Meinander served as a professor of economics at Hanken School of Economics, was a member of the Parliament of Finland from 1945 to 1962, and served as Minister of Finance in 1957.
